Dashboard layout template defining a grid and its zones.
Defines a reusable dashboard layout template. Each template has a number of grid columns and one or more zones where widgets can be placed.
A widget assigned to a dashboard instance and zone.
Represents a chart/report widget placed on a dashboard instance within a specific zone. Each combination of Dashboard Instance and Report must be unique.
A placement zone within a dashboard template grid.

Defines a rectangular zone inside a dashboard template grid where widgets can be placed. Its position (PosX, PosY) and size (Width, Height) must fit within the template grid columns, and it restricts which chart types are allowed and how many items it may hold.
A dashboard instance owned by a user or a role.
An instance of a dashboard template assigned to an owner. The owner is either a User or a Role depending on the Owner Type; exactly one of them must be set.

Template zones crossed with their compatible chart types

Dynamic dictionary view that lists each active template zone paired with every chart type it accepts. A chart type is compatible when the zone's Allowed Types is empty (accepts all) or explicitly contains the chart type code.
Template zones crossed with their compatible chart types

Dynamic dictionary view that lists each active template zone paired with every chart type it accepts. A chart type is compatible when the zone's Allowed Types is empty (accepts all) or explicitly contains the chart type code.
JOIN AD_Ref_List rl ON (rl.AD_Reference_ID=53377 AND rl.IsActive='Y' AND (z.AllowedTypes IS NULL OR (',' || z.AllowedTypes || ',') LIKE ('%,' || rl.Value || ',%')))
Template zones with their compatible chart types

Smart Browser that shows, for each active dashboard template zone, every chart type it accepts. A chart type is compatible when the zone's Allowed Types is empty (accepts all types) or explicitly lists the chart type code.
Zonas de plantilla con sus tipos de gráfico compatibles

Smart Browser que muestra, para cada zona de plantilla de tablero activa, cada tipo de gráfico que acepta. Un tipo de gráfico es compatible cuando los Tipos Permitidos de la zona están vacíos (acepta todos los tipos) o listan explícitamente el código del tipo de gráfico.
A Client is a company or a legal entity. You cannot share data between Clients. Tenant is a synonym for Client.
An organization is a unit of your client or legal entity - examples are store, department. You can share data between organizations.
The record is active in the system

There are two methods of making records unavailable in the system: One is to delete the record, the other is to de-activate the record. A de-activated record is not available for selection, but available for reports. There are two reasons for de-activating and not deleting records: (1) The system requires the record for audit purposes. (2) The record is referenced by other records. E.g., you cannot delete a Business Partner, if there are invoices for this partner record existing. You de-activate the Business Partner and prevent that this record is used for future entries.
The Created field indicates the date that this record was created.
The Updated field indicates the date that this record was updated.
The Created By field indicates the user who created this record.
The Updated By field indicates the user who updated this record.
